# Municipal Ordinance No. 004, Series of 2013

**A Resolution Abolishing Certain Positions in the Municipality of Pitogo, Quezon**

Resolution No. 058

## Summary

Abolishes five (5) positions in the [[Municipality of Pitogo]] that have been vacant for more than five years.

Absent: [[Dexter L. Sayat]], [[Jose Nonato G. Querrubin Jr.]]

## Key Provisions

- **Positions Abolished:**
  1. Revenue Collection Clerk 1 (Item No. 8, [[Municipal Treasurer's Office]])
  2. Agricultural Technologist 1 (Item No. 3, [[Municipal Agriculturist Office]])
  3. Midwife 1 (Item No. 8, [[Municipal Health Office]])
  4. Midwife 1 (Item No. 9, [[Municipal Health Office]])
  5. Librarian 1 (Item No. 1, [[Municipal Library]])
- **Reason for Abolition:** All five positions have been vacant for more than five years
- **Legal Authority:** Per [[Sec-76-RA7160]] on organizational structure and staffing pattern

## Entities

- [[Sangguniang Bayan]]
- [[Municipality of Pitogo]]
- [[Dante L. Punac Sr.]] — Municipal Mayor
- [[Rodante V. Cortes]] — Vice Mayor / Presiding Officer
- [[Municipal Treasurer's Office]]
- [[Municipal Agriculturist Office]]
- [[Municipal Health Office]]
- [[Municipal Library]]

- [[Sec-76-RA7160]] — Organizational structure and staffing pattern
